subject: Língua Portuguesa
description_pt: Criar narrativas ficcionais, tais como contos populares, contos de suspense, mistério, terror, humor, narrativas de enigma, crônicas, histórias em quadrinhos, dentre outros, que utilizem cenários e personagens realistas ou de fantasia, observando os elementos da estrutura narrativa próprios ao gênero pretendido, tais como enredo, personagens, tempo, espaço e narrador, utilizando tempos verbais adequados à narração de fatos passados, empregando conhecimentos sobre diferentes modos de se iniciar uma história e de inserir os discursos direto e indireto.

components.description_pt: Construir narrativa ficcional que inclua elementos estruturais como enredo, personagens, tempo, espaço e narrador
components.description_en: Construct a fictional narrative that includes structural elements such as plot, characters, time, setting, and narrator
components.cc_component_description: Construct a story that includes a theme, complication, resolution, and logical event sequence

components.description_pt: Aplicar tempos verbais apropriados para narração de eventos passados em narrativa ficcional
components.description_en: Apply verb tenses appropriate to narration of past events in a fictional narrative
components.cc_component_description: Use simple, progressive, and perfect verb tenses to convey specific times and sequences

components.description_pt: Incorporar discurso direto e indireto apropriadamente em narrativa ficcional
components.description_en: Incorporate direct and indirect speech appropriately within a fictional narrative
components.cc_component_description: Use quotation marks to indicate direct speech or a quotation from a text

components.description_pt: Selecionar estratégias de abertura narrativa adequadas ao gênero ficcional pretendido
components.description_en: Select narrative opening strategies suited to the intended fictional genre
components.cc_component_description: Orient an audience to the context and point of view at the opening of a narrative

components.description_pt: Adaptar convenções de narrativa ficcional ao gênero específico sendo produzido, como conto, mistério ou história em quadrinhos
components.description_en: Adapt fictional narrative conventions to the specific genre being produced, such as folk tale, mystery, or comic book
components.cc_component_description: Apply knowledge of register and rhetorical conventions to revise writing for effect

cc_matches.description:
Multilingual learners will construct language arts narratives that
* Orient audience to context __and point of view__
* Develop and describe characters and their relationships
* Develop story, __including themes with complication and resolution,__ time, and event sequences
* Engage and adjust for audience
Use verb tense to convey various times, sequences, states, and conditions.
Use commas and quotation marks to mark direct speech and quotations from a text.
Apply knowledge of language to understand how language functions in different contexts, to make effective choices for meaning or style, and to comprehend more fully when reading or listening.
